page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin notes on the left, beside the lines "Amasi inter Occonem" and "ra eum adegit". Page number and running head at the top.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif?. inter Lavic?. & Amaf.

main_text.l: cam, item idem, & omnes socii in agro
vicino cum Octapagicis Transflavicanis
anno M. cccc. xxv i. de coercendis furibus
pacta iniere. Deinde hæc ad Orientem
Amasi inter Occonem & Focconem
dissensione enatâ, atque armis commo-
tis, cum Occonis fortuna labasceret,
Focco Groninganis succensens Occoni
fœderi junctis, trajecto cum suis Amaso,
& excitata illic factione sua, prælio Gro-
ninganos vicit; victorque in patriam
reversus Occonem in pugna cepit: ite-
rumque primo vere anni M.cccc.xxv i i i.
Amaso transmisso, aspirante undique
fortuna, totum penè agrum, qui inter
Amasum & Lavicam est, à civitate a-
vertit, & in novas leges ac nova fœde-
ra eum adegit. Sed Medachiorum,Hum-
merziorum, Langowoldiorum, Fredo-
woldiorum multi non assensêre, & fœ-
dus etiam cum Groninganis, finito jam
fœdere priore, pro libertate & legibus
priscis rursum pepigêre, in quo appellatio

l.i: ad Hovetmannos urbanos à judicibus cæte-
ris in agro litigantibus permissa, & ut con-
ventus juridici quatuor quotannis agantur in urbe,

page.notes: Running head and the abbreviations "Frif." and "Lavic." are uncertain; the scan is faint at the head. The note "Fœdus renovatū." is printed as two lines and is set here as one note. The printed headline shows a "Tumultus / bellici cis / ultraque / Amasum." marginal note, transcribed as one. The bottom-right faint watermark and the vertical rule at the right edge are not printed text and are left out.
